teaser.en: A creeping finger grass whose seed heads spread out like the fingers of a hand.
teaser.sw: Nyasi inayotambaa ambayo vishada vyake vya mbegu hutawanyika kama vidole vya mkono.
teaser.dg: Nyasi inayoambala photsi, ambayo vitswavye vya tembe vinatawanyika dza vyala vya mkpwono.

summary.en: Mkuse is a finger grass, a perennial grass with slender, finger-like seed heads, recognised by Digo speakers from the look of the whole plant.
summary.sw: Mkuse ni nyasi ya jenasi *Digitaria* (*finger grass*), nyasi ya kudumu yenye vishada vyembamba vya mbegu vilivyo kama vidole; Wadigo huitambua kwa sura ya mmea mzima.
summary.dg: *Mkuse* ni nyasi ya aina inayoihwa kpwa Chingereza *finger grass*: nyasi inayokala na moyo kpwa miaka minji, yenye vitswa vyembamba vya tembe vinavyohalana na vyala. Atu anaogomba Chidigo nkuimanya kpwa sura ya mmea wosi.

about.en:
*Mkuse* is a perennial grass, often spreading by runners along the ground, with tufts of upright stems. Its flowering heads are made of several slender spikes that spread from near the top of the stem like fingers, which is why grasses of this genus are called finger grasses.

Pakia's informants identified it from the look of the whole plant.
about.sw:
*Mkuse* ni nyasi ya kudumu, ambayo mara nyingi husambaa kwa vitawi vinavyotambaa ardhini, na yenye vichala vya mashina yaliyosimama wima. Vishada vyake vya maua vimeundwa na masuke kadhaa membamba yanayotawanyika kutoka karibu na ncha ya shina kama vidole; ndiyo sababu nyasi za jenasi hii huitwa kwa Kiingereza *finger grasses* ('nyasi-vidole').

Watoa taarifa wa Pakia waliitambua kwa sura ya mmea mzima.
about.dg:
*Mkuse* ni nyasi inayokala na moyo kpwa miaka minji. Mara nyinji inaenea kpwa milita mire inayoambala photsi, na ina mabunda ga visinde vinavyoima chocho. Vitswavye vya maruwa vina seemu chache nyembamba, zinazotawanyika kula phephi na dzulu ya chisinde dza vyala; ndiyo sababu nyasi za jenasi ihi kpwa Chingereza zinaihwa *finger grasses*.

Atu ambao Pakia wauza akaimanya kpwa sura ya mmea wosi.

where.en: It grows in grassland, open bushland and fallow land, often on sandy soils. The species is widespread in eastern and southern Africa.
where.sw: Inaota katika nyika za nyasi, vichaka vilivyo wazi na mashamba yaliyoachwa, mara nyingi kwenye udongo wa mchanga. Spishi hii imeenea sana mashariki na kusini mwa Afrika.
where.dg: Inamera kpwenye herera za nyasi, weruni wa wazi na minda iriyorichwa, mara nyinji kpwenye ulongo wa mtsanga. Aina ihi inaphahikana phatu phanji kpwenye seemu za mashariki na za kusini za Afrika.

uses.en: Elsewhere in Africa this species, known in English as Milanje finger grass, is valued as a pasture grass and is grown for grazing and hay. Pakia records no Digo use.
uses.sw: Katika sehemu nyingine za Afrika, spishi hii, inayojulikana kwa Kiingereza kama *Milanje finger grass*, inathaminiwa kama nyasi ya malisho na hupandwa kwa ajili ya malisho na nyasi kavu za lishe. Pakia haandiki matumizi yoyote miongoni mwa Wadigo.
uses.dg: Phatu phanjina Afrika, aina ihi, inayoihwa kpwa Chingereza *Milanje finger grass*, ina samani dza nyasi ya marisa, na nkuphandwa kpwa kurisa mifugo na kuphaha nyasi kavu za kurisa. Pakia kaandika matumizi ga Adigo.

names.en: Pakia records *mkuse* with no meaning. The Mgombato dictionary lists *Mkuse* only as the name of a Digo spirit, and the link, if any, between the grass and the spirit is unknown. There is no English or Swahili name in Pakia.
names.sw: Pakia anaandika *mkuse* bila kutoa maana yake. Kamusi ya Mgombato inaorodhesha *Mkuse* tu kama jina la pepo wa Kidigo, na uhusiano, kama upo, kati ya nyasi hii na pepo huyo haujulikani. Pakia hatoi jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *mkuse* bila mana. Kamusi ya Mgombato inaandika *Mkuse* tu dza dzina ra pepho ya Chidigo, na taimanyikana kukala kuna uhusiano kahi ya nyasi ihi na pepho iyo. Pakia kaandika dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili.

reason.sw: Eleusine, nyasi ya kawaida inayoota kama gugu
reason.dg: Eleusine, nyasi ya kawaida inayomera dza mbondo

reason.en: Heteropogon, a grass of the same grasslands
reason.sw: Heteropogon, nyasi ya nyika hizo hizo
reason.dg: Heteropogon, nyasi inayomera kpwenye herera zizo
